rationale: An exact attested native monetary-unit noun in this reviewed WordNet branch denotes a denomination, a coin distinguished by its denomination, or a currency amount in deposit. The denomination or amount has the same definitional identity across different desires of holders, depositors, and counterparties. WANT=0 records that orthogonality for the witnessed monetary role. Copper as the coin material, trade financing as an application, and economic value as a relation among denominations do not introduce a conative argument into the unit. The ancestry and native lemma guards confine the rule to exact source senses, including where their spellings have unrelated meanings.
